text: You are a young code apprentice in the magical land of Codyssey, a land powered by ancient principles known as Object-Oriented Principles.
A mysterious dark glitch has corrupted these principles, causing instability in the structure of our land.
To restore balance, you must embark on a sacred journey across the Realms of Knowledge, mastering the lost principles and gathering the Legendary Crystal — Karstal.
I entrust you with the critical mission. Only by reclaiming the six realm badges and the Karstal can you heal Codyssey and awaken its true strength once more.
The path ahead begins at the House of Blueprint... Step forward, apprentice. Destiny awaits.
